title: ArchitecturePrinciple
description: TOGAF-sourced directive archetype — a qualitative statement of intent that guides architecture decisions. Enriches Directive with rationale and implications links. The base Directive already carries governance grammar (modal, verb, qualifier, purpose); Principle adds TOGAF-specific justification vocabulary. Requires GSM unsealing of Directive to be functional. Extends Directive with TOGAF Architecture Principles vocabulary. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Principle (Preliminary Phase, Architecture Principles). Source framework: TOGAF (Architecture Principles).

rationale.description: Justification for why this principle exists. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Principle rationale (mandatory per TOGAF Preliminary Phase).

implications.description: Consequences of adopting this principle — impacts on architecture, organization, and resources. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Principle implications.

scope.description: Principle applicability scope. TOGAF mapping: Architecture Principle governance scope.
